    def __iter__(self):

    def __next__(self):
        if self._index is not None:

            else:

                return item

    def seek(self, index):
        self._index = index
        remainder = index - len(self._cache)

        # Current logical position is len(cache) regardless of _index state
        new_pos = len(self._cache) + offset
        if new_pos < 0:

        if maxlen is None:

        self._index = None
        self._last_yielded = -1  # Index of last yielded item
